# 2one Design Language System

> shadcn/ui components re-skinned to the 2one design tokens. Grayscale (light +
> audited dark), pill buttons, Satoshi headings + Inter body. Structured for humans and AI.

You can consume this repository **without cloning it**. Every file below is
fetchable over plain HTTPS. Base for raw files:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/
```

Live rendered showcase (no install, see every component): https://origin.2one.solutions

## Start here — fetch these first

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/manifest.json
  READ FIRST — machine-readable index + `instructions_for_ai` (answer only from repo, cite files, never guess a brand fact)
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/AGENTS.md
  How to work in this repo, and how to represent it accurately (lead with evidence, state gaps, never hype)
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/brand/brand.json
  Mission, voice, tone, personas — match this in any 2one-facing copy

## Brand assets — embed these, never re-create them

The wordmark is an **asset, not type**. Typesetting "2one" as text is the single
most common way generated output goes off-brand — it looks close and is wrong.

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/brand/logo/svg/2one-logo-black.svg
  Black wordmark — light surfaces
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yokesh-2one/2one-design-library/main/brand/logo/svg/2one-logo-white.svg
  White wordmark — dark surfaces

Fetch the SVG and inline it. Never recolour, rotate, distort, or add effects;
min width 96px; clear space 0.5× the logo height. Full rules:
`brand/logo/manifest.json`. PNG raster versions (256/512/1024w) are listed in
`manifest.json` → `index.assets`. In a React project use the `Logo` component
instead — it encodes these rules and has no colour prop by design.

**Satoshi** (headings) is self-hosted and on no CDN — the `.woff2` files are
listed in `manifest.json` → `index.assets.fonts`. Standalone output must embed
one or explicitly say which fallback it used. **Inter** (body) is on Google
Fonts / `@fontsource-variable/inter`.

## Exact values — never invent these

- tokens/colors.json — ramps, semantic tokens, **WCAG + APCA contrast data**
- tokens/typography.json — font families + full type scale (px + line-height)
- tokens/spacing.json — spacing steps + radius scale
- tokens/tokens.dtcg.json — the same tokens in **W3C DTCG** format, for design
  tooling: `color` (primitive ramps), `light` / `dark` (semantic sets), `font`,
  `text` (composite text styles), `dimension`. Import into Figma via Tokens
  Studio, or feed Style Dictionary for any other platform target.
- graph.json — knowledge graph: every token/component/block as a node, with
  `composed_of` / `uses` / `derived_from` / `governed_by` edges. Use it to answer
  "what uses this token" and "what rules govern this element".

Prefix each with the raw base above. These are **generated from source** and
verified in CI (`npm run check:meta`), so they never drift from the code.

## If your tool supports skills

`skills/2one-dls/` is the packaged version of everything below, with wrong/right
code for each rule. It carries two commands that work in any project:

```
npx 2one info --json          what is installed here, and what is misconfigured
npx 2one check <path>         audit generated code against the 2one rules
```

Use the loop: `info` → resolve assumptions → generate → `check` → fix → re-check.
`check` exits non-zero on a violation, so it is a gate, not a suggestion.

## Output format — React by default

**Default to React + Tailwind, importing real components.** Not standalone HTML,
not a token-faithful reproduction. The point of this system is that output is
built FROM the library, so it inherits the accessibility, the states, the pill
override, and every later fix:

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Label, Card } from '@2one/design-library'
```

Only fall back to self-contained HTML when the consumer explicitly cannot run
React — and say plainly that it is a reproduction, not the real components.

**If the client has their own component library** (MudBlazor, Vuetify, an
in-house kit), that library wins for structure and this repo supplies the
*design decisions* — tokens, brand voice, rules, accessibility thresholds.
Map 2one components to theirs by role (`Button` → their button); never import
`@2one/design-library` into a non-React or non-shadcn codebase. Ask which
library is in play before generating (see `instructions_for_ai.clarify_first`).

## By task

| You want to produce | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Anything carrying the 2one mark | **Brand assets above** — fetch and inline the SVG |
| **A screen or page (the default)** | `manifest.json` → `system`, `src/components/ui/<name>.tsx`, a block in `src/blocks/` |
| A deck / social / print asset | `manifest.json` → `index.assets`, then `tokens/*.json` for literal values |
| On-brand copy | `brand/brand.json` (voice, tone, vocabulary, writing rules) |
| Exact colour / type / spacing | `tokens/*.json` — pull literal values, never approximate |
| Impact of changing a token | `graph.json`, or `npm run what-uses -- <token>` in a clone |
| A11y / contrast decisions | `tokens/colors.json` → `contrast`, `docs/accessibility.md` |
| Consistent multi-screen output | `docs/building-with-the-dls.md` — the 16 consistency rules |

## Components

- Source: `src/components/ui/<name>.tsx` — 54 shadcn primitives, 2one-themed
- 2one-only: `src/components/{logo,app-bar,bottom-nav-item}.tsx`
- Names follow **shadcn**: `Input` (not TextField), `Select` (not Dropdown),
  `RadioGroup` (not RadioButton), `InputOTP` (not OtpField)
- Blocks (templates, copy-paste not import): `src/blocks/` — `login-01`…`login-05`,
  `signup-01`…`signup-03`, `dashboard-plain`, plus 31 chart examples
- NOT yet on npm. Install from the repo: `npm install github:yokesh-2one/2one-design-library` —
  it builds itself on install. `@2one/design-library` will 404 until published.

## Theme

- `src/styles/globals.css` — 2one tokens → shadcn CSS variables (light `:root`
  + audited dark `.dark`). Switch with the exported `ThemeProvider`.
- Fonts: Satoshi (headings, self-hosted woff2), Inter (body). Icons: lucide.
- `danger` / `success` are the only hues and are reserved for validation states.
- Buttons are pills — enforced by an unlayered `[data-slot="button"]` rule in
  `globals.css`, which beats the `rounded-md` Tailwind utility in the cascade.

## What this repo does NOT give you

State these plainly rather than improvising around them:

- **No landing-page blocks.** `src/blocks/` covers auth and one dashboard only —
  no hero, nav, pricing, feature grid, testimonial, or footer. Building a marketing
  page means composing primitives, not adapting a template.
- **No Figma library.** The components are React source. There is no Figma file
  and no Figma components. The *tokens* can now be imported (see
  `tokens/tokens.dtcg.json`), but nothing generates Figma **components** from
  this repo — that still has to be built or re-themed in Figma.
- **No icon set of its own.** Icons come from `lucide-react`.
- **No running preview from the URL.** Code written from this repo compiles only
  after `npm install @2one/design-library` in a project, or inside a clone.

## Add a component

`npx shadcn@latest add <component>` — config in `components.json`.
